# PosterArt

The 2:3 artwork for a show or movie, used at every size so posters look identical across the app.

`TVTracker.PosterArt` · Media

## Use

```jsx
<TVTracker.PosterArt title="…">…</TVTracker.PosterArt>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="TVTracker.PosterArt" title="…">…</x-import>
```

## Props (PosterArtProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` * | `string` |  |
| `image` | `string` | Poster image URL (2:3). Without it, initials on bg-raised. |
| `width` | `number` | Width in px; height follows at 2:3. Default 132. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | Overlays (toggles) placed inside the art. |
